mapper.select: select a.id, a.slug, s.slug as space_slug, a.title_zh, a.coach_tip from practice_activities a join practice_spaces s on s.id = a.space_id where a.scene_tag_en = #{sceneTagEn} order by a.id asc limit 1
select id, slug, step, english, chinese, pronunciation, difficulty from practice_phrases where activity_id = #{activityId} order by step asc, id asc
select slug from practice_spaces order by sort_order asc, slug asc
insert into practice_spaces (slug, title_zh) values (#{slug}, #{titleZh}) on conflict (slug) do nothing returning id

insert into practice_activities (slug, space_id, title_zh, scene_tag_en, coach_tip, source) values (#{slug}, #{spaceId}, #{titleZh}, #{sceneTagEn}, #{coachTip}, 'llm') on conflict (slug) do nothing returning id

insert into practice_phrases ( slug, activity_id, step, english, chinese, pronunciation, difficulty, source ) values ( #{slug}, #{activityId}, #{step}, #{english}, #{chinese}, #{pronunciation}, #{difficulty}, 'llm' ) on conflict (slug) do nothing returning id
select id, slug as space_id, title_zh, description_zh, sort_order from practice_spaces order by sort_order asc, slug asc limit #{limit}

select a.id, a.slug as activity_id, s.slug as space_id, a.title_zh, a.scene_tag_en, a.coach_tip, a.sort_order, a.source from practice_activities a join practice_spaces s on s.id = a.space_id where s.slug = #{spaceId} order by a.sort_order asc, a.slug asc limit #{limit}

select p.id, p.slug as phrase_id, a.slug as activity_id, p.step, p.english, p.chinese, p.pronunciation, p.difficulty, p.audio_asset, p.source from practice_phrases p join practice_activities a on a.id = p.activity_id where a.slug = #{activityId} order by case when p.difficulty = 'starter' then 0 else 1 end, p.step asc, p.id asc limit 1

with current_phrase as ( select p.step from practice_phrases p join practice_activities a on a.id = p.activity_id where a.slug = #{activityId} and p.slug = #{currentPhraseId} limit 1 ) select p.id, p.slug as phrase_id, a.slug as activity_id, p.step, p.english, p.chinese, p.pronunciation, p.difficulty, p.audio_asset, p.source from practice_phrases p join practice_activities a on a.id = p.activity_id where a.slug = #{activityId} and p.step > (select step from current_phrase) order by p.step asc, p.id asc limit 1
